whether is useful, but not a priority because you can replace it with if

candidates.ownerNote:
can't speak english without this -- however, you shouldn't be adding to do something as a tag, that is nothing more than  the placeholder text,

good job with full infinitive because verbs have six forms: to do something (full infinitive), do something, does something, did something, done something, doing something and it's important to mark down which to use

perhaps "followed by full infinitive" would be a better name

howeever the "full infinitive" tag doesnt make sense because necesitar is just the root lemma form, which we convert to present, past. etc.

in fact, need to go through database and mark down verbs that are naturally followed by full infinitive, bare infinitive, etc.

also place holder text needs to be marked in square brackets  to need [to do something]

example.spanish: Quiero irme.

candidates.rationale: Needa represents the informal spoken reduction of need to. It belongs under necesitar + action but is a separate Supporting entry because it is pronunciation/register guidance, not the standard written form.

candidates.ownerNote: also, another point, eat out can have a sexual connotation of oral sex -- we do not want to include sexual vocabulary in the course, students will figure that out on their own
